binding_review.reason: Independent metadata-only review of the actual prepared context binding and files. Parent freeze commitments, preparation inventory/intent, request digests, derived task/spec hashes and previous independent science/declaration approvals match actual bytes. The entire common specification is unchanged after removing only parameters.active_context; all three contexts use identical generator and evidence bytes. No model parameter, distribution or source evidence was changed during bridge preparation. The fixed initial schedule has exactly five 5000-row slots: MIND seed3101, Ayele seed3102 and target seeds2101-2103, reserving two source/10000 rows and three target/15000 rows within the frozen execution limits. Every task retains the exact ordered id,age,sex,bmi,glucose columns and units1,year,1,kg/m^2,mmol/L. Context populations agree with the mandatory case-guard contract: MIND61-80 inclusive, Ayele25-64 inclusive by Methods with caption caveat retained, and target>=40 with no upper eligibility cutoff. Common age-column bounds remain absent; this approval does not replace the mandatory whole-frame context guard during actual execution. The separately approved18-source descriptive declaration is unchanged and its engine hashes remain current. No generator import/execution, parameter fit, generated table inspection, target data read or test execution was performed. Approval establishes prepared binding consistency, not successful execution, exact source replay, assay equivalence or target scientific validity. This source binding retains semantic_v1 feedback, the approved source recipe and measurement descriptor, and correctly bound evidence/recipe hashes. Strict source checks remain not_computable with null operators; the separately approved equal-weight descriptive reports are approximations, not target feedback.
